latest.title: Deploying a Web Application with AWS Elastic Beanstalk
latest.description:
Deploying an application on AWS can involve configuring servers, networking, security groups, load balancing, scaling, monitoring, and application environments.For developers who want to focus more on their application code and less on manually managing infrastructure, AWS Elastic Beanstalk provides a simpler deployment experience.
In this article, I’ll explain how Elastic Beanstalk works, its architecture, and the basic workflow for deploying an application.

latest.title: Standardizing Builder Recognition: Lessons & Logistics from an AWS AIdeas Top 50 Finalist
latest.description: This article highlights operational and communication delays in the AWS AIdeas post-competition process from the perspective of a Top 50 Finalist. It pairs a brief technical overview of the app *Rakshak* with documented email evidence showing months of missed credential deadlines and unanswered follow-ups. The piece explains how these delays prevent student developers from satisfying university recognition requirements and offers constructive recommendations to improve builder program transparency.

trending.title: AWS Amazon S3: A Beginner-Friendly Guide to Cloud Storage
trending.description:
Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) is an object storage service provided by AWS. It is designed to store and retrieve large amounts of data from anywhere through the internet.

S3 is commonly used for storing images, videos, documents, backups, application files, logs, and static website files.
